summary: Produced the backend design artefact for EXT-05 at src/design/ext-05-sub-process-support.md. The design defines SUB_PROCESS activation semantics, durable parent-child linkage, parent token WAITING behavior, child start path reuse from EE-01, variable copy-on-start and merge-on-child-complete via EE-09, event payload contracts for CHILD_PROCESS_ERROR and CHILD_PROCESS_CANCELLED with both parent_instance_id and child_instance_id, explicit non-cascading parent-cancel behavior, child definition snapshot stability when source definitions change after start, engine ordering constraints, persistence touchpoints, EE-10 error propagation mapping, and a complete requirement traceability matrix with required unit and integration tests.

tests_run.name: design completeness and traceability review
tests_run.detail: Validated all handoff acceptance criteria are mapped to explicit behavior, contracts, ordering, persistence touchpoints, EE-10 transitions, and verification hooks for EXT-05 and its edge cases.
